idea: Build QuickBite, a student meal planner app with dorm recipes and cooking timers
tagline: Master dorm room cooking with microwave-ready recipes, appliance timers, and dining swipe tracking.
targetAudience: College and university students living in dormitories or micro-apartments with limited cooking equipment (e.g., microwaves, mini-fridges, electric kettles, air fryers), tight food budgets ($30-$50/week), minimal culinary experience, and busy academic schedules.

mvpFeatures.name: Strict Equipment Filter Mode
mvpFeatures.description: Filter recipes exclusively by available dorm appliances such as 'Microwave Only', 'Electric Kettle Only', 'Air Fryer', or 'No Prep/No Cook'.

mvpFeatures.name: Appliance-Calibrated Cooking Timers
mvpFeatures.description: Interactive multi-stage timers calibrated for dorm tools, featuring microwave power-level pause alerts, stir notifications, and air fryer turn reminders.

mvpFeatures.name: Mini-Fridge & Budget Guardrail Recipes
mvpFeatures.description: Recipes restricted to 5 ingredients or fewer that intentionally maximize ingredient reuse across weekly meals to fit small mini-fridge spaces and avoid food waste.

mvpFeatures.name: Campus Dining Hall Hybrid Planner
mvpFeatures.description: Weekly scheduler combining campus dining hall meal swipe days with supplemental quick dorm-cooked meals to optimize meal plan value.

mvpFeatures.name: Smart Mini-Fridge Grocery List
mvpFeatures.description: Categorized grocery list optimized for small-batch purchases, consolidating common ingredients across selected weekly recipes.

futureFeatures.name: AI Mini-Fridge Leftover Generator
futureFeatures.description: Snap a photo or input leftover mini-fridge ingredients to generate instant dorm-appliance recipes.

futureFeatures.name: Community Dorm Hacks & Recipe Feed
futureFeatures.description: User-generated student recipes, dorm life cooking hacks, and localized store deal alerts.

futureFeatures.name: Campus Dining Hall Menu Sync API
futureFeatures.description: Direct integration with university dining hall daily menus to automatically recommend complementary dorm meals.

userPersonas.name: Alex - College Freshman in Standard Dorm
painPoints: Only owns a microwave, mini-fridge, and electric kettle
Overspends on food delivery app fees during late-night study sessions
Groceries frequently spoil because the mini-fridge is cramped
goals: Cook quick, warm meals in under 10 minutes inside the dorm room
Keep weekly out-of-pocket grocery spending under $35

userPersonas.name: Maya - Junior with Partial Meal Plan
painPoints: Runs out of dining hall meal swipes before the week ends
Has an air fryer but lacks quick, student-friendly recipe ideas
Struggles to balance cooking with back-to-back classes and lab work
goals: Plan dining hall visits alongside 15-minute air fryer meals
Track remaining meal swipes while keeping dorm pantry stocked with basic staples

userJourneys.flowName: Appliance Setup & Weekly Hybrid Meal Planning
userJourneys.description: User configures available appliances, weekly dining swipe count, and receives a tailor-made weekly meal plan.
steps: User launches app and selects available appliances (Microwave, Electric Kettle, Mini-Fridge).
User inputs weekly campus meal swipe count (e.g., 10 swipes/week).
App generates a hybrid 7-day schedule assigning swipe days and 5-ingredient dorm meals for non-swipe slots.
User reviews automatically generated, small-batch grocery list.

userJourneys.description: User selects a 5-minute microwave mug meal and follows the multi-stage interactive timer.
steps: User selects '5-Minute Microwave Mac & Cheese' from the filtered home feed.
Step 1 timer runs for 2 minutes at High Power for water boiling.
Audio and vibration prompt alerts user to add pasta & cheese, then stir.
Step 2 timer runs for 90 seconds at 50% Microwave Power to prevent boilovers.
Cooking complete prompt displays final rest timer and nutrition summary.

screens.name: Appliance & Profile Setup Screen
screens.purpose: Capture user's dorm cooking equipment, food budget, and meal swipe quota
keyComponents: Appliance Checkbox Grid (Microwave, Air Fryer, Kettle, Hot Plate)

screens.name: Home Dashboard Screen
screens.purpose: Display daily hybrid meal plan, meal swipe balance, and quick cooking launchpad
keyComponents: Daily Hybrid Schedule Widget (Dining Hall vs Dorm Meal)

screens.name: Recipe Detail & Prep Screen
screens.purpose: Provide ingredient checklists and step-by-step prep instructions optimized for dorm constraints

screens.name: Guided Appliance Cooking Mode Screen
screens.purpose: Full-screen interactive multi-stage cooking timer with appliance-specific instructions

screens.name: Smart Mini-Fridge Grocery Screen
screens.purpose: Consolidated shopping list categorized by aisle with mini-fridge volume management cues

routes.name: Dashboard
routes.description: Main daily overview and hybrid meal schedule tab

routes.name: Grocery
routes.description: Aggregated budget and mini-fridge optimized shopping list

routes.name: Onboarding
routes.description: Initial setup flow for appliance profile

techStack.frontend: React Native / Expo (TypeScript) with React Native Reanimated for Timer UI
techStack.hosting: Render (Backend API) / Expo Application Services (Mobile Build)

monetizationModel: Freemium model. Free tier includes access to basic microwave recipes, manual swipe tracking, and standard single-stage timers. 'QuickBite Pro' premium subscription ($2.99/month or $19.99/year) unlocks multi-stage appliance timers, mini-fridge ingredient reuse optimizer, air fryer recipe library, and meal swipe auto-scheduling.
